issues.title: Package may not exist
issues.description: `geojson` is not declared, installed, or local. This package is not in the standard library, not a local module, not declared in any manifest, and not installed. AI models regularly invent package names — and attackers register those names with malware ('slopsquatting').
issues.suggested_fix: Check whether the package really exists and is the one you meant. Replace it with a real, maintained package (or the standard library) and declare it in the manifest — don't just `pip install`/`npm install` the name.

issues.title: Colored neon glow shadows
issues.description: 2 occurrences in this file (lines 63, 136). Big colored glows and glowing orbs (shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(…)], radial-gradient(color, transparent)) are the dark-mode AI template look in any hue — mint, cyan or violet. They blur edges and compete with content.
issues.suggested_fix: Use neutral elevation from the theme (shadow-sm/shadow-md or a 1px border). Reserve color for the one primary action.

issues.title: Palette sprawl
issues.description: 94 distinct hardcoded colors across the project (71 in this file). Dozens of distinct hardcoded hex colors means there is no design system — every screen drifts a little.
issues.suggested_fix: Define color tokens (CSS variables or tailwind theme) for the handful of colors you need and replace raw hex values with them.

design_context:
- Surfaces & text tokens available: `muted` — use these instead of raw colors.
- Icon library: `lucide-react` — use it for every icon; never emoji.
